in_marathi.name: Jaganath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaganath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaganath is derived from the Sanskrit words Jagat (universe) and Ish (Lord), meaning 'Lord of the Universe'. In Hinduism, Jaganath is a form of Lord Vishnu, who is believed to protect and nurture the universe and all its beings.
